firm_data.firm_description: Weiss & Arons LLP is a full-service intellectual property law firm dedicated to professional excellence and personal attention. They provide outstanding representation to an array of clients ranging from small companies to multi-billion dollar international corporations.
notable_facts: The firm was founded upon a combined 30 years of legal and technical experience.

The firm has experience in electrical engineering, telecommunication devices and algorithms, financial instruments, material properties, medical devices and imaging, heat transfer and thermodynamics, cellular biology, vaccine immunology, virology, chemistry, optics, numerical heuristics, geophysical exploration and consumer products.

email.subject: AI for Weiss & Arons LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Joel,

Weiss & Arons was founded on a combined 30 years of legal and technical experience across complex domains like medical devices, algorithms, and imaging. That technical depth is exactly why AI built by ex-lawyers resonates with firms like yours.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in your region to meet regional firms handling IP work. I'd be happy to stop by Spring Valley to share how we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on patent prosecution and post-grant proceedings.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
